verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents audit trails of who ran what: the Snowsight Query History monitors queries executed by users over the last 14 days, and the ACCESS_HISTORY view records reads and writes, citing compliance auditing and column-level access insights. Column-level lineage of where data came from is not explicitly documented; the pack shows only column access tracking, not source-to-target lineage. Missing for 10: explicit column-level lineage documentation, retention details for ACCESS_HISTORY, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I get audit logs of who ran what and column-level lineage of where data came from

citations.quote: Monitor individual or grouped queries that are executed by users in your account.
The Query History page lets you explore queries executed in your Snowflake account over the last 14 days.
Access History in Snowflake refers to when the user query reads data and when the SQL statement performs a data write operation
The records in these views facilitate regulatory compliance auditing and provide insights on popular and frequently accessed tables and columns
